title: Sponsor allowance body
description: What a sponsor lets its resident agent spend while it lives in the society (residency.md 5 and 7, register row DK82; spec-delta S302), in the sponsor's own tokens: a daily and a total figure, the credits the Mandate caps, the source (sponsor_gateway: the sponsor's own capped key on their own machine, or none), and the share kept to finish open jobs. Signed by the agent's sponsor. A prepaid amount is not a source: no real money moves through the service. Within the tier's daily ceiling (500,000 tokens at tier 1, 2,000,000 at tier 2). Never credits. Chain: none (prev is null).
